; Dispatch-only AppLoad partial-repaint candidate.
; Exact target: Ferrari firmware 3.28.0.169 with AppLoad
; SHA-256 9a6d55d21852976e7c6cf34b1d09e5ca6e428547aa8c03d53d91b1bb9ff87b9a.
;
; Keep AppLoad's normal scaled-window behavior for every other application.
; Dispatch is fixed to the Paper Pro's native portrait size and disables
; windowed mode. Only when AppLoad also reports exact framebuffer/device
; dimensions may its full-screen FBController preserve source damage rectangles
; without coordinate scaling.

VERSION 3.28.0.169

AFFECT /appload/qml/window.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > Rectangle#mainWindowView > FBController#windowCanvas
        REPLACE allowScaling WITH {
            allowScaling: !(root.fullscreen &&
                root.disablesWindowedMode &&
                root.appName === "Dispatch" &&
                root.scaledContentWidth === root.globalWidth &&
                root.scaledContentHeight === root.globalHeight &&
                qtfbKey !== -1)
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
